header.name: Ramesh Kumar
header.long_desc: I'm a software engineer specializing in creating awesome Android applications, from prototype to fully functional end product.

about.title: About Me
details: Hello! I'm Ramesh, an Android engineer based in Los Angeles. I enjoy building apps that live in people's pockets, taking them from the first prototype to a polished release on the Play Store.

I started out in Sindh, Pakistan, where I set up the Android department at Next Generation Innovation and later led the Android team at Startrum, shipping an encrypted chat app used by over 100,000 farmers. Today I'm a Senior Android Engineer at Thrive Market, working on shopping features, payments and the move to Kotlin.
I hold a Master's in Computer Science from Maharishi International University.

experience.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Redesigning the Thrive Market Android app, leading team initiatives and managing Play Store releases
Launched the Shopping List feature and built Guided Shopping for better product recommendations
Implemented fraud prevention with the Braintree SDK and migrated core classes from Java to Kotlin
Owned unit tests, UI tests and memory profiling while working closely with iOS, backend and product teams

experience.title: Lead Android Developer

Built an encrypted chat app connecting over 100,000 farmers with agriculture experts
Created a custom SDK for event, error and view tracking
Shipped Tree Media Feed, the Karachi Golf Club app, Ittendance and iEvent

experience.title: Applications Engineer
bullets: Built the Android department from the ground up
Sourced, hired, trained and supervised three Android developers
Delivered an eCommerce app, the ReadSpeed game and the eQuiz trivia game

experience.title: Android Developer
